pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Sandworm Nest.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Defense and tactics
pages.text: The worm has separate segments. A damaged segment receives 30% more initial damage; subsequent defenses still apply. Hitting it can trigger a retaliatory spit. Focus a damaged segment, then change position after attacking. JEM scales the segment-damage threshold with maximum health.

pages.title: Starting combat
pages.text: Waiting for Start on a dedicated server is separate preparation protection. Start combat from the boss encounter menu. In singleplayer use native awakening; server parties and JEM Raid are unavailable there.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Sirok Gauntlet. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Campaign
pages.text: In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Black Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
